# Ludic Canvas

React UI for browser games, using Yoga WASM and WebGL 1.

- [Guide](https://libraries.ludic-canvas.victorqueiroz.dev/guide/)
- [API](https://libraries.ludic-canvas.victorqueiroz.dev/api/)
- [Playable example](https://libraries.ludic-canvas.victorqueiroz.dev/play/)
- [Source](https://github.com/VictorQueiroz/ludic-canvas)
